notes: Dimensions name the vocabulary already defined in AUDIO-SCRIPT.md rather than restating it, in particular the narration/delivery/segment separation (§2) and the two-pass QA split (§20).

dimensions.asks: Does the script sound like something written to be heard, or like an article read aloud (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §1)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: Recompiled reasoning, not a transcript of the written piece.

dimensions.asks: Is the spoken unit a listenably complete thought, without an artificial short-sentence quota (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §4)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: One claim, causal step, qualification, comparison, or consequence per unit.

dimensions.asks: Do transitions state the relationship itself (cause, limit, reversal), or announce script machinery (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §7)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: A transition that would be missed if removed, because it carries logic.

dimensions.asks: When an idea returns, does it return with a new function, or as filler repetition (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §6)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: A recurring thesis restated with a narrower or clearer consequence.

dimensions.asks: Does pace vary with the material's difficulty, or run at one uniform speed regardless of content?
dimensions.adopt_signal: Slower pacing at genuinely hard inferences, not decorative pace changes.
dimensions.imitation_risk: medium — a specific performed pace is delivery, not a rule to copy

dimensions.asks: Are load-bearing names, acronyms, and mixed-language terms given an explicit, provider-neutral spoken form (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §11)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: A pronunciation decision recorded as editorial metadata, not left to a backend default.

dimensions.asks: Is delivery direction augmented from what the register/audience already imply, or an invented persona (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §12, §18)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: Compact, stable direction: register + audience + global constraints + sparse local cues.
dimensions.imitation_risk: high — a specific vocal character or persona is the reference's own performance, not a transferable technique

dimensions.asks: When multiple speakers are used, does the split serve a genuine information function rather than manufacturing energy (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §15)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: A speaker split that maps to distinct argumentative roles.

dimensions.asks: Do assumed knowledge and aside frequency match a named audience's attention context (V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §3 table)?
dimensions.adopt_signal: Assumed-knowledge and aside choices that would change if the audience changed.

not_authoritative_for: Rendered voice identity, provider, model, or vendor-specific control syntax — those are adapter concerns per AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §19, never craft evidence.
Whether a claim spoken in the script is true or a new derived claim requires re-verification (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §3) — this profile evaluates listening structure, not fact.
Timing/duration correctness for a specific rendering — that is Render QA (AUDIO-SCRIPT.md §20), not a reference craft trait.
selection_hints: Match applicable_to.artifacts to the requested audio/* artifact (monologue vs dialogue vs timed-narration) before matching pace or performance style.
performance-delivery is the dimension most often do_not_copy; select it only when the evaluation explicitly marks it adopt, not merely because the reference's audio is well produced.
